findings.text: _revision_blob already owns the "blob id a revision carries for a path" capability, so the added _blob_id at reckon/crew/merge.py:244 duplicates it rather than extending it; merge.py cannot import promotion_scope (which imports merge at reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2413), so a shared owner would have to be a third module.

The case named for the text file's marker check drops reviewed.txt entirely, so it reaches the absent-path refusal at reckon/crew/merge.py:434 and never the marker comparison at reckon/crew/merge.py:447-455; a regression that broke the marker comparison would not redden this gate.

The refusal "the merge altered a binary file the change carried" also fires when the head's path was text and the merge produced a binary blob, so the wording misnames the kind of change for a reader triaging the refusal.
